data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱1,709,000 – ₱2,499,000 (Varies by trim, drivetrain, and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,900 × 1,865 × 1,865 Wheelbase (mm): 2,850 Seating Capacity: 7
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.5 L 4-Cylinder Turbo Diesel (YD25)
Maximum Output: ~190 hp Maximum Torque: ~450 Nm
Transmission: 6-speed Manual or 7-speed Automatic
Drivetrain: Rear-Wheel Drive (2WD) or Part-Time 4WD (depending on variant)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Up to ~2,500–3,000 kg (variant-dependent)
Payload Capacity: Approx. 650–700 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 80 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 7 (three-row SUV)
Infotainment: 8”–9” touchscreen with Apple CarPlay / Android Auto Speakers: 6–8 standard; Bose premium audio system on higher trims
Interior Features: Leather seats, power adjustments, rear entertainment (variant-dependent)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Ventilated Disc
Suspension: Double Wishbone front Multi-Link rear with coil springs
Tires / Wheels: 17” Alloy (lower trims) 18” or 20” Alloy (higher trims)
Ground Clearance: Approx. 225 mm
